**Test build for Nexo 1.2**: two new plugins to play together in voice channels, **Retro games** and the
**Emulator**, for friends on test builds to try before everyone gets them. Everyone else stays on v1.1.0.

> **Hosts:** these plugins need the server from this test build too. Until the server runs it, turning
> them on in **Settings → Plugins** fails with "Unknown plugin". After that, an admin turns them on (both
> are off by default).

## Retro games

Five arcade games, all original. In a voice channel, click the new **gamepad** button and pick one:

- **Blast Arena** (2–4 players): drop bombs in a maze, blow up crates for power-ups, be the last one standing.
- **Kart Rally** (1–8): kart racing with drifts, boosts and items on three tracks.
- **Ring Out** (2–4): platform fighting. The more damage someone has, the farther they fly.
- **Dojo Duel** (2): one-on-one fighting with special moves.
- **Color Rush** (2–8): match the color or the number and empty your hand first. Don't forget to call **RUSH!**

Whoever opens a game hosts it: friends **Take a seat**, the host adds **bots** for empty seats and
presses **Start**. The server runs every match, so everyone sees the same game. Play with the keyboard
(arrows/WASD, Space, J, K, L, I) or an Xbox-style controller.

## Emulator

Play SNES games you own, together. In the game picker choose **Your own game** and load a `.sfc`, `.smc`
or `.zip` file from your computer. Nexo runs it and streams it to the call. Friends take **controller
2–4** and play with their own keyboard or controller; four players work in games that support the SNES
multitap. The file stays on your computer, and Nexo doesn't provide games.

## What to test

None of this has been played by real people yet:

- **Feel**: do the action games (Blast Arena, Ring Out, Dojo Duel, Kart Rally) feel responsive for
  everyone, not only the host? Your moves show up after your ping.
- **Bots**: are they fun, too easy or too hard?
- **Emulator**: load a game you own. Does it run at full speed with sound? Can friends play on
  controllers 2–4, and how much delay do they notice? Is the stream sharp?
- **Controllers**: do Xbox-style controllers work right away (press a button once)?
- Anything that looks wrong in the light theme or a small window.

## Leaving test builds

Already on a test build? Nothing to do: Nexo updates itself. To go back to the regular releases:
**Settings → App → Updates → Leave test builds**, then restart Nexo.
